summary: In the single known-target frontend CPU-stress v3 sanity, scoped typed deletion completed 63.9 seconds after injection and was followed by three workload windows meeting the predeclared thresholds before the 180-second fault expiry; the trace records oracle PASS and independently recorded cleanup absence, while raw technical-probe and contemporaneous pod-runtime evidence are incomplete.

gt_provenance.details: The target service/fault and confidence 0.99 are supplied by the known injection contract; one live Chaos object is the evidence, not a learned RCA output. HTTP observations are measured; no fabricated model-derived reference was found. This supports a known-target contract sanity, not diagnosis accuracy.

score_normalization.details: Every raw latency, nearest-rank p95, successes/elapsed throughput and error count agrees. The 1.2 latency and 0.8 throughput gates use separate no-fault calibration, not a prediction maximum. All 20 windows/3000 requests are retained.

result_existence.details: All specified files and numbers exist and recompute; no phantom success found. Technical booleans and canaries cannot be independently reconstructed from raw response evidence because that evidence was not retained. V3 has no contemporaneous pre/post pod snapshots.

dead_code.details: The live sanity directly calls measure/collector, planner, YAML gate, preconditions, execution, technical collector and evaluate_recovery. Saved plan/YAML/preconditions and oracle replay exactly. The optional build_business_oracle callback is not this runner path and contributes no claimed result.

scope.details: Three attempts, two injected episodes, one completed typed mutation/oracle PASS; one namespace, frontend, CPU stress, no learned RCA/LLM, no randomized control or matched no-action episode. Preserve failures and changed environment versions; do not infer causal advantage, general safety, persistent-state integrity or a success rate.

checks.eval_type_detail: Legacy taxonomy: no independently evaluated learned diagnosis ground truth; measured workload relative to a no-fault calibration. Precise subtype: controlled_live_known_target_contract. This is real isolated-cluster HTTP measurement, not simulation or model-generated synthetic data.

static_bindings.details: Baseline v1/v2 content digests and v3 approved manifest/path match; changed baseline bytes, manifest bytes and old baseline path reject in offline replay.

timing_freshness.details: All windows are ordered; v3 completion at 63.9213 seconds precedes 150-second deadline; post-window end ages 93.9389,124.9662,155.9936 seconds and oracle evaluation all precede 180-second expiry. Freshness ages 62.4446,31.4174,0.3900 seconds are below 120 seconds.

target_plan_execution.details: V1/v3 evidence and precondition JSON match exact kind/name/namespace/service and active injected controller status; plan/YAML/captured hashes reproduce. V1 Ansible import failure has no typed mutation; v3 deletion output/rc0 precede cleanup.

technical_raw_evidence.details: Oracle replay trusts three saved Boolean technical predicates; raw technical probe rows absent. Later admin NotFound provides separate raw cleanup absence evidence but cannot reconstruct scoped technical read timing/response.

cleanup.details: All three attempts retain cleanup rc0 and independent exact-target GET rc1/NotFound with no cleanup errors. V1 rollback apply says unchanged and is not a third injected episode.

baseline_runtime_snapshots.details: V2 baseline has stable 12 pod UIDs/container IDs, 24 Ready containers and zero restart counts across embedded pre/post snapshots. Baseline v1 lacks a post-snapshot.

sanity_runtime_snapshots.details: No contemporaneous pre/post v3 pod-runtime snapshots exist in audit artifacts. Executor-reported immediate post-run health was not persisted and is not promoted to verified evidence.

natural_expiry.details: Actual v3 active precondition evidence, successful named deletion at 63.9 seconds, and all three post-windows before 180 seconds rule out declared automatic expiry as the observed PASS mechanism for this trace. No no-action control means no causal treatment-effect estimate.

denominators.scope: one namespace, one service, one fault profile; different setup/code versions; no success-rate estimate

claims.claim: In the single known-target frontend CPU-stress v3 sanity, scoped typed deletion completed 63.9 seconds after injection and was followed by three workload windows meeting the predeclared thresholds before the 180-second fault expiry; the trace records oracle PASS and independently recorded cleanup absence, while raw technical-probe and contemporaneous pod-runtime evidence are incomplete.
Measured learned diagnosis accuracy or graph-to-repair benefit
Causal recovery improvement versus no action/direct repair
Persistent-state preservation or universal runtime stability

warranted_statement: In the single known-target frontend CPU-stress v3 sanity, scoped typed deletion completed 63.9 seconds after injection and was followed by three workload windows meeting the predeclared thresholds before the 180-second fault expiry; the trace records oracle PASS and independently recorded cleanup absence, while raw technical-probe and contemporaneous pod-runtime evidence are incomplete.

source_provenance.historical_snapshot_origin: Reconstructed post hoc by executor by reversing prospective raw-evidence patch; independently hash-verified against review-pinned digest.
source_provenance.current_workload_oracle_usage: Post-v3 prospective raw-evidence patch; not execution-time provenance and does not retroactively supply missing probe records.
source_provenance.limitation: Trace pins baseline and manifest, not all executed source files. Current audit source snapshots are retained separately.

limitations: HTTP raw diagnostics retain sorted latencies and aggregate success counts, not per-request response/status/timestamps or raw canary response.
Baseline v1 has no post-runtime snapshot; v3 has no contemporaneous pre/post runtime snapshot.
Technical booleans are recorded without their source probe output.
Only one successful known-target episode; no no-action comparator or repeated matched trials.
Environment changed through sidecar stabilization between v2 attempt and v3; p95 comparison is not randomized.
action_items: Keep all three attempts and both baseline versions in reporting with distinct attempt/injection/completion denominators.
Before prospective expansion, persist raw timestamped technical/RBAC/canary evidence and pre/post pod UID/container/restart/ready snapshots; do not backfill v3 with later state.
Freeze source/content identities at launch and retain them with future traces.
Use a predeclared matched no-action/direct-repair protocol with repetitions before causal or comparative recovery claims.
